title: Retain the exact stationary identity and every outlet assumption
statement: For A=L_adjoint stationary in rho,Hermitian nuisance O and O_j=A^jO on a common domain with finite moments,if[L_l,O_j]=0 for EVERYphysical outlet and j<r,then at regular nonzero frequencies S_O(omega)=omega^-2r S_Or(omega). Stationary/singular lines must be handled separately;regularized resolvent has an extra2eta||R||rho^2term. With sufficient correlation smoothness/decay/integrable remainder,the symmetric tail has coefficient sum_l<[L_l,O_r]^dag[L_l,O_r]>/omega^(2r+2). This is not Gaussian and retains common nonlinear dynamics,but finite-frequency suppression still needs the remaining spectrum/resonances bounded. Complex modulation needs the cross-spectral matrix/both sidebands. Direct storage-loss jumps fail the initial commutation condition. Existing Lindblad spectral-moment precedent is credited,no priority finding.
